source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Environmental and Social Impacts (PDF 136, printed 132).

blocks.text: Computing mahol aur muashre par kai tarah asar dalti hai. Technology bijli kharch karti, electronic kachra paida karti aur aloodgi (pollution) mein hissa dalti hai. Saath hi technology samaji rawaiye, baat-cheet aur saqafat (culture) par asar dalti hai. Mahol aur muashre par asraat samajhna digital tools ke zimmedarana istemal ko barhata hai. Sustainable (paidar) tareeqe aur muashre par asraat ka shaoor technology ko fitrat aur muashre ke saath tawazun mein rakhne ke liye zaroori hain.

blocks.prompt: Computing mahol (environment) aur muashre par kaise asar dalti hai? Do do misalein dein.
blocks.explanation: Mahol: bijli ka kharch, electronic waste, pollution. Muashra: samaji rawaiye, communication aur saqafat par asar.

items: Technology: bijli, e-waste, pollution; samaji rawaiye aur saqafat par asar.
Sustainable practices se technology, fitrat aur muashre mein tawazun.
